# TwisterTools

> 100% free, fast, privacy-first, browser-native online utilities and calculation engines.

TwisterTools is a rapidly expanding, privacy-first ecosystem of hundreds of client-side web tools, calculators, generators, and converters designed to execute entirely in the user's browser memory (RAM). By utilizing modern browser-side technologies—including native JavaScript, WebAssembly, HTML5 Canvas, and the Web Cryptography API—TwisterTools guarantees zero-latency execution without transmitting user files, sensitive data, code, or cryptographic keys to remote servers.

## Web & SEO Tools (web-tools)
- [Meta Tag Generator & Social Preview Inspector](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/meta-tag-generator): Generate SEO-optimized HTML meta tags, Open Graph properties, and Twitter Cards with live previews for Google, Facebook, & X. 100% client-side & secure.
- [Open Graph Meta Tag Generator & Social Card Suite](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/open-graph-generator): Build Facebook, LinkedIn, and social media Open Graph tags. Preview rich card images, post titles, and descriptions prior to publishing.
- [WHOIS Domain Age Checker & Expiration Auditor](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/domain-age-checker): Query live WHOIS registries to inspect domain creation dates, total active age, registrar information, expiration milestones, and trust metrics.
- [Domain to IP Converter & DNS Inspector](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/domain-to-ip): Instantly resolve domain names into IPv4/IPv6 addresses, inspect A-records, ISP metadata, and server locations.
- [IP Location Lookup & GeoIP Visualizer](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/ip-location): Inspect IPv4/IPv6 locations, ASN telemetry, ISP network data, and interactive location maps.
- [DNS Record Finder & Name Server Inspector](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/find-dns-record): Instantly query and inspect live DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA) across global resolvers with full TTL telemetry.
- [SSL Certificate Checker](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/ssl-checker): Check SSL certificate validity. Verify SSL/TLS certificate expiration dates, CA issuer trust chains, and security ciphers.
- [HTTP Headers Inspector & Response Code Analyzer](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/http-headers): Inspect HTTP response headers, check HTTP status codes, and analyze web security header policies.
- [XML Sitemap Generator & URL Crawler Suite](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/sitemap-generator): Compile Sitemaps.org compliant XML, TXT, and HTML sitemaps for Google Search Console.
- [What Is My IP Address & Network Inspector](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/what-is-my-ip): Check your public IPv4/IPv6 address, ISP details, geolocation, and connection security in real time.
- [Subnet Mask & IPv4 CIDR Range Calculator](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/subnet-cidr-calculator): Calculate IPv4 network ranges, broadcast addresses, usable IP spans, wildcard masks, and VLSM subnets client-side.
- [IPv6 to IPv4 & Hexadecimal Address Expander](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/ipv6-address-converter): Enterprise-grade IPv6 address expander, RFC 5952 compressor, IPv4-mapped address extractor, 128-bit binary visualizer, and ip6.arpa reverse DNS PTR generator.
- [Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Generator](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/csp-header-generator): Generate hardened Content Security Policy Level 3 headers with presets for Next.js, WordPress, and zero-trust security.
- [HTTP Status Code Reference & Diagnostic Header Matrix](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/http-status-code-checker): Lookup RFC 9110 HTTP status codes, diagnose API response headers, inspect cURL commands, and test live endpoints in real time.
- [Canonical URL Link Tag & Cross-Domain Audit Formatter](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/canonical-url-tag-builder): Generate, sanitize, and validate canonical link tags, HTTP response headers, hreflang clusters, and cross-domain rel=canonical markup with instant SEO audit diagnostics.
- [llms.txt & llms-full.txt Generator for AI Search](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/llms-txt-generator): Generate standard-compliant /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt files to optimize your website for LLM crawlers, AI search agents, and GEO. 100% browser-based with multi-language and Greek support.
- [Schema.org FAQPage & Article JSON-LD Microdata Builder](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/schema-jsonld-generator): Generate Google-compliant JSON-LD structured data for FAQPage, Article, NewsArticle, and BlogPosting schemas.
- [SPF Record Generator & Permissive Syntax Validator](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/spf-record-generator): Generate, test, and audit RFC 7208 SPF records. Detect the 10 DNS lookup limit, avoid Permerrors, and prevent unauthorized email spoofing.
- [DMARC Policy TXT Record Formatter & Reporting Tool](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/dmarc-record-generator): Generate RFC 7489 compliant DMARC TXT records with custom policy levels, aggregate rua and forensic ruf reporting tags, and DKIM/SPF alignment.
- [DKIM Selector Public Key Record Inspector & Generator](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/dkim-record-generator): Inspect, generate, and validate RFC 6376 DKIM DNS TXT records with 2048-bit RSA key health diagnostics.
- [Browser User-Agent Client Hints (UA-CH) Header Inspector](https://www.twistertools.com/tools/web-tools/client-hints-inspector): Inspect, simulate, and generate RFC 8942 User-Agent Client Hints (Sec-CH-UA), Accept-CH headers, and Nginx proxy rules.
